# Code of conduct

BetterFy is a small project with one maintainer. Issues, pull requests, and
discussions work best when they stay specific, respectful, and grounded in
evidence.

## Expected

- Describe what you observed, on which build, and what you expected.
- Separate what you saw yourself from what someone else reported.
- Critique the work, not the person.
- Respect the privacy of other players: do not post their account names,
  Steam IDs, Telegram identities, or screenshots that show them.

## Not accepted

- Harassment, insults, or discriminatory language.
- Publishing another person's private information.
- Sharing cheats, account-trading offers, or instructions for bypassing
  anti-cheat systems.
- Posting third-party game assets or mod archives without the right to
  redistribute them.

## Enforcement

The maintainer, [@zori-xyz](https://github.com/zori-xyz), may edit, hide, or
lock content, and may block accounts that repeatedly break these rules. To
report a problem, contact the maintainer through GitHub instead of replying in
the thread.
